template_hash_scope.note: The baseline hashes template code, config, content assets, includes, layouts, liquid fragments, scripts, translations and static metadata. It excludes top-level Publisher onLoad/onGenerate/onCheck/JIRA products, cache.ini, and versions.txt; ant.xml generates versions.txt from the current IG. packagelist.txt is a deterministic ant-hl7.xml output from packagelisturl and remains hash-checked as a configuration-derived compatibility value.

runtime_generated_file_included_in_fixed.reason: ant-hl7.xml writes this file from the fixed packagelisturl property. The current output is deterministic for that property but may change if the configured URL changes; the baseline intentionally continues to catch such a change.
